directPaymentDiscovery.scope: All public charging points explicitly listed by Stadtwerke Traunstein on the current operator page; all are Type 2 AC points and the page states they have the same access methods.
directPaymentDiscovery.note: The operator explicitly states that the ladeapp web app is reached through the QR code on the charging station and gives the gross ad-hoc price of 0.49 EUR/kWh. Contract/RFID prices remain governed by the card issuer and are not promoted into the direct tariff.

reason: Current official operator page publishes one exact ad-hoc price and states that all listed public charging points share the same access options, so no station-level extrapolation is required.
